row.name: Mandalorian Combat Aptitude
row.description: +1 DX, Composed, High Pain Threshold, +1 to Guns (Blaster Rifle) & Armoury (Body Armor).

row.name: Bilingual
row.description: You were raised speaking two languages. Add one additional Language at Native fluency, written on the sheet at [0] and noted (Bilingual). May be taken only at character creation.

row.name: Mandalorian Equipped
row.description: Clan-issued armor and first weapon received as a gift. Remains clan property - not sold or traded (Ch4, Gifted Gear).

row.name: Code of Honor (Mandalorian)
row.description: Adherence to strict Mandalorian codes of honor and combat.

row.name: Intolerance (Non-Mandalorians)
row.description: Hold disdain or suspicion towards outsiders ('arueti').

row.name: Social Stigma (Warrior Culture)
row.description: Seen as brutal warmongers or raiders.

row.name: Adherent to a Mandalorian Tradition
row.description: You follow a minor, specific Mandalorian custom, even if you are not Mandalorian. This could be tapping your chest before combat, refusing to sit with your back to a door, or reciting a particular proverb in stressful situations.

row.name: Armoury (Body Armor)
row.notes: Ch18 prints 12 - 11 bought, +1 from Mandalorian Combat Aptitude, applied at roll time.

row.name: Guns (Blaster Rifle)
row.notes: Ch18 prints 15 - 14 bought, +1 from Mandalorian Combat Aptitude, applied at roll time.

row.name: Mandalorian Recon Helmet
row.effects: 1hr Vacuum environment seal capable. +5 Head DR vs energy damage

row.name: Mandalorian Recon Cuirass
row.effects: 1hr Vacuum environment seal capable. +5 to Torso & Arms DR vs energy damage

row.name: Mandalorian Recon Greaves
row.effects: 1hr Vacuum environment seal capable. +5 to Legs DR vs energy damage

loadedAmmunitionData.name: Rifle Power Pack
loadedAmmunitionData.notes: A larger, more robust pack used for rifles and carbines. A gas top-up (30 CR) refills it to full; free electric recharging restores the cell only, never spent gas. Bundled with the weapon — its cost and weight are already in the weapon's own figures.

loadedAmmunitionData.name: Standard Power Pack
loadedAmmunitionData.notes: The universal power source for pistols and other small arms. A gas top-up (15 CR) refills it to full; free electric recharging restores the cell only, never spent gas. Bundled with the weapon — its cost and weight are already in the weapon's own figures.

row.name: Rifle Power Pack
row.notes: Spare packs for the Mandalorian Assault Rifle - clan gift, not deducted (Ch18).

row.name: Heavy Stagger-Pulse Modulator
row.notes: On hit, target must make an HT-2 roll or be physically Stunned for 1d sec.

row.name: Vibration Generator
row.notes: Adds +1d cut/imp. Grants Armor Divisor (3). Needs a successful Computer Programming skill check to function if constructed.

row.name: Power Cell
row.notes: Provides baseline power for attached emitters/generators.

template.description: A proud warrior from a minor Mandalorian clan, loyal to Mandalore the Ultimate. Ready-to-play character.
